answer_html:
Definition

An Adapter class gives blank default bodies for all methods of a listener interface that has multiple methods.

Key points

  • Examples: MouseAdapter, KeyAdapter, WindowAdapter, FocusAdapter, MouseMotionAdapter.
  • Avoids writing empty methods you do not need when implementing a listener interface directly.
  • You override only the method you care about.
Listener interfaceAdapter class
MouseListener (5 methods)MouseAdapter
KeyListener (3)KeyAdapter
WindowListener (7)WindowAdapter
FocusListener (2)FocusAdapter
MouseMotionListener (2)MouseMotionAdapter

Note

ActionListener has only 1 method, so it has no adapter.

options: To avoid writing empty listener methods
